description:
This protocol automates the distribution of process buffer from the Lyra Direct SARS-CoV-2 Assay into a 96-well format.
Using an Opentrons P300 8-Channel Pipette, this protocol will transfer 400µL of process buffer from a 12-well reservoir to the specified number of wells in a 96-well plate.


If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at protocols@opentrons.com.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.21.0 or later)
Opentrons P300 8-Channel Pipette, GEN2
Opentrons 300µL Tip Rack
NEST 12-Well Reservoir
Eppendorf 96-Well Plate
Lyra Direct SARS-CoV-2 Assay Kit



Deck Layout

Slot 1: Opentrons 300µL Tip Rack

Slot 4: Eppendorf 96-Well Plate

Slot 7: NEST 12-Well Reservoir
Process Buffer Loading: Each column of the reservoir can contain enough buffer for up to 24 wells. Ex: if running 96 wells, columns 1-4 should be loaded with buffer
